plugins.locationAlwaysAndWhenInUsePermission: {appName} uses your location when you announce car line pickup and, if you turn on automatic check-in, to notice when you arrive at school. Teachers and staff who agree also send it when they answer a critical alert, so the office can find them; only alert senders see that, and it's erased after the alert. Your location is never tracked.

plugins.locationWhenInUsePermission: {appName} uses your location when you tap I'm here at car line pickup, so the school knows you've arrived. Teachers and staff who agree also send it when they answer a critical alert, so the office can find them; only alert senders see that, and it's erased after the alert. Your location is never tracked.

plugins.photosPermission: {appName} lets you choose photos for your profile, your children, activities, school photo albums and Marketplace items.
